text_en: When the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the returned exiles were building a temple to the Lord , the God of Israel,
text_cn: 犹大和本雅明的敌人，一听说充军回来的子民，为上主以色列的天主修建殿宇，

text_en: they approached Zerubbabel and the heads of families and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we worship your God as you do, and we have been sacrificing to him ever since the days of King Esar-haddon of Assyria who brought us here. ”
text_cn: 便来见则鲁巴贝耳、耶叔亚和族长，向他们说：“让我们同你们一起建筑罢！因为我们同你们一样，求问你们的天主；自从亚述王厄撒哈冬，将我们带到这里之日起，我们即向他献祭。”

text_en: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of families in Israel said to them, “You shall have no part with us in building a house to our God; but we alone will build to the Lord , the God of Israel, as King Cyrus of Persia has commanded us. ”
text_cn: 但是，则鲁巴贝耳、耶叔亚和以色列的族长，回答他们说：“你们不能同我们一起，给我们的天主修建殿宇，因为按波斯王居鲁士给我们出的命令，我们应单独给上主以色列的天主修建殿宇。”

text_en: Then the people of the land discouraged the people of Judah, and made them afraid to build,
text_cn: 当时便有当地人来挫折犹大人民的勇气，扰乱他们建筑的工程；

text_en: and they bribed officials to frustrate their plan throughout the reign of King Cyrus of Persia and until the reign of King Darius of Persia.
text_cn: 还买通了一些参议员，来反对他们，破坏他们的计划；整个波斯王居鲁士朝代，自始至终，直到波斯王达理阿朝代，常是如此。

text_en: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in his accession year, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
text_cn: 在薛西斯朝代，在他登极之初，他们还写了诉状，控告犹大和耶路撒冷的居民。

text_en: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam and Mithredath and Tabeel and the rest of their associates wrote to King Artaxerxes of Persia; the letter was written in Aramaic and translated.
text_cn: 阿塔薛西斯年间，彼舍蓝、米特达特、搭贝耳和其余的同僚，也曾上书于波斯王阿塔薛西斯；奏文是用阿剌美文字，也是用阿剌美语言写的。

text_en: Rehum the royal deputy and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows
text_cn: 以后，勒洪总督和史默瑟秘书，为耶路撒冷事，也曾上书于阿塔薛西斯王，其文如下：——

text_en: (then Rehum the royal deputy, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their associates, the judges, the envoys, the officials, the Persians, the people of Erech, the Babylonians, the people of Susa, that is, the Elamites,
text_cn: 上书的是勒洪总督、史默瑟秘书和其余的同僚：即判官和钦差、波斯书记、厄勒客人、巴比伦人、叔商人即厄蓝人，

text_en: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar deported and settled in the cities of Samaria and in the rest of the province Beyond the River wrote—and now
text_cn: 以及伟大和显贵的阿斯纳帕所遣来，安置在撒玛黎雅城和河西其余地区的各民族。——

text_en: this is a copy of the letter that they sent): “To King Artaxerxes: Your servants, the people of the province Beyond the River, send greeting. And now
text_cn: 以下是送于王的奏文副本：“你的臣仆，河西的人民上奏阿塔薛西斯王：

text_en: may it be known to the king that the Jews who came up from you to us have gone to Jerusalem. They are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city; they are finishing the walls and repairing the foundations.
text_cn: 今上奏大王，前由大王那里上到我们这里来的犹太人，一到了那座作乱邪恶的耶路撒冷城，便大兴土木，修建城墙，现已打好基础。

text_en: Now may it be known to the king that, if this city is rebuilt and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and the royal revenue will be reduced.
text_cn: 今上奏大王，那城若是建成，城垣若是修完，他们便不再纳粮、出捐和完税了，如此于大王的国库必定有害。

text_en: Now because we share the salt of the palace and it is not fitting for us to witness the king’s dishonor, therefore we send and inform the king,
text_cn: 现今我们既食王家的盐，自不应坐视大王受害，为此我们上奏，禀告大王：

text_en: so that a search may be made in the annals of your ancestors. You will discover in the annals that this is a rebellious city, hurtful to kings and provinces, and that sedition was stirred up in it from long ago. On that account this city was laid waste.
text_cn: 请大王查阅先王记录，在记录上必会查出，从而知道这城是座好乱的城，曾加害先王和各省；自古以来，其中常发生叛乱，故此才被毁灭。

text_en: We make known to the king that, if this city is rebuilt and its walls finished, you will then have no possession in the province Beyond the River. ”
text_cn: 为此，我们奏明大王：如果那城建成，墙垣筑完，从此大王便没有河西的版图。”

text_en: The king sent an answer: “To Rehum the royal deputy and Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their associates who live in Samaria and in the rest of the province Beyond the River, greeting. And now
text_cn: 君王复文如下：“愿勒洪总督、史默瑟秘书、以及其余住在撒玛黎雅的官员，和河西其余的人民平安：

text_en: the letter that you sent to us has been read in translation before me.
text_cn: 你们呈来的奏疏，已在我们前清楚诵读了。

text_en: So I made a decree, and someone searched and discovered that this city has risen against kings from long ago, and that rebellion and sedition have been made in it.
text_cn: 我下命检查，的确发现那座城，自古以来即违抗君王，其中常发生叛乱造反的事。

text_en: Jerusalem has had mighty kings who ruled over the whole province Beyond the River, to whom tribute, custom, and toll were paid.
text_cn: 先前曾有英武的君王，治理过耶路撒冷，统辖过整个河西之地，人都给他们纳粮、出捐和完税。

text_en: Therefore issue an order that these people be made to cease, and that this city not be rebuilt, until I make a decree.
text_cn: 所以现在，你们应发一道命令，叫这些人停止，不准修城，直到我们另发指令。

text_en: Moreover, take care not to be slack in this matter; why should damage grow to the hurt of the king? ”
text_cn: 你们应注意，对此不可疏忽，免得损害加重，祸及君王。”

text_en: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum and the scribe Shimshai and their associates, they hurried to the Jews in Jerusalem and by force and power made them cease.
text_cn: 当阿塔薛西斯王的复文副本，在勒洪、史默瑟秘书和他们同僚前，诵读之后，这些人就急速前往耶路撒冷，来到犹太人那里，用威胁和武力迫使他们停工。

text_en: At that time the work on the house of God in Jerusalem stopped and was discontinued until the second year of the reign of King Darius of Persia.
text_cn: 于是耶路撒冷天主殿宇的工程，便停顿了，一直停到波斯王达理阿在位第二年。
